alert.title: Admin Proximity Alert
alert.body: Two sets of shoes in the hallway, moving slower than passing-time shoes. One of them is AP Reyes.

actions.label: Advance the slide off yesterday's warm-up
actions.blurb: 3 seconds. You will have to stop talking.

actions.label: Get Milo back in his seat
actions.blurb: 3 seconds. He will narrate the whole walk back.

actions.label: Count five full seconds before calling on anyone
actions.blurb: 2 seconds to set up. Satisfies a look-for. Feels like an hour out loud.

actions.label: Do nothing. Teach the lesson.
actions.blurb: Uses your whole turn. The lesson you were already teaching keeps going.

bridge.title: They step back into the hall.

prompts.line: "I clocked about two seconds between your question and the first hand. Talk to me about wait time."

choices.label: "You're right — I'll count to five in my head before I call on anyone."
choices.blurb: Fidelity +. You now owe a follow-up.

choices.label: "Two seconds is how long it takes them to decide it's not a trick question."
"That's a great point, I'll add it to my growth plan."

count.line: "Good. I'll listen for it next time I'm in."

closing.title: Observation complete
closing.body: You'll see the write-up in your email. Eventually.
